subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding national interest as a primary driver of a country's foreign policy decisions
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Strategic Thinking Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described foreign policy decision to the national interest it likely serves (security, economic, diplomatic)
exercise.abstract: Student explains what national interest is and identifies one in a described foreign policy scenario

misconception_flags: believes foreign policy decisions are made with no underlying strategic reasoning at all

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
